_note: Lighting variants for the golden-hour shot (Phase 0 milestone 5). Read by tools/ue/lighting.py. Sun: elevation above the horizon, azimuth = world yaw of the direction TOWARD the sun (UE yaw: 0 = +X, 90 = +Y). The main building facade and the front gates face +X, so azimuth near 0 front-lights them and azimuth near 60-90 rakes across them. intensity_lux is the atmosphere sun light (UE multiplies it by the atmosphere transmittance). Exposure is LOCKED: auto exposure min = max = exposure_ev100 (project uses ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange, so those are EV100), identical for every frame of a variant; critique rounds are comparable. Interiors are exposure-neutral by construction: they sit on lighting channel 1, the sun and sky-leak are kept off them, and a private interior key light (lighting channel 1 only) brings them to the same EV as the exterior, so no per-pocket exposure volume (which would pop at door transitions) is needed.

A_classic_gold.description: Low warm sun in front of the facade (az 28, el 12): front-lit gates and facade, long shadows falling back toward the building, light haze.

B_raking_amber.description: Lower, side-on amber sun (az 62, el 9): strongly raking light across the facade, very long shadows, deeper orange, cooler blue shade.

C_rose_haze.description: Higher, softer sun (az 12, el 15) through thin pale-rose haze; lower contrast, cooler sky and shade, gentle atmosphere.
